capabilities.name: Public Website
capabilities.description: The nine-page public institutional interface: presentation, metadata, sitemap/robots, branded 404, security headers, static rendering. A stable, bounded public interface — not the container for future institutional systems.

capabilities.name: Inquiry Intake
capabilities.description: Server Action accepting public inquiries: server-side validation, abuse controls, persistence to the contact_inquiries table. The only substantive runtime institutional capability today.
unresolvedDecisions: Retention period for inquiry records awaits the owner's data-retention decision (fed by the future legal review).

capabilities.name: Notification Service
capabilities.description: Internal inquiry email notification (Resend over fetch), implemented and hardened but deliberately not_configured in production. Persistence never depends on it.
unresolvedDecisions: Activation timing and recipient confirmation are owner decisions (launch checklist Phase 4).

capabilities.name: Institutional Knowledge Foundation
capabilities.description: The machine-readable knowledge layer over the governed docs/ corpus: metadata schema, corpus manifest, deterministic validation (ADR-0001). File-based; no runtime service.
unresolvedDecisions: Classification and authority tier of the documentation index (recorded in the manifest).
Machine-consumption eligibility is unresolved corpus-wide pending AI governance.

capabilities.name: Future Institutional Knowledge System
capabilities.description: A future system extending the knowledge foundation beyond file-based artifacts: richer storage, retrieval, and controlled cross-system consumption of governed institutional knowledge.
unresolvedDecisions: Whether and when file-based artifacts stop sufficing (trigger: a consumer needs queryable or permissioned access).
Storage and repository topology (ADR-0003/ADR-0004 criteria apply when triggered).

capabilities.name: Institutional Method Library
capabilities.description: Governed internal corpus of Huerta Group methodology. The repository-based foundation is complete (the full approved Methodology Foundation v1 source, architecture, schema, registry, eight approved records, validation); substantive future methods remain blocked pending approved methodology substance (MFv1 §10.8).
unresolvedDecisions: Substantive future methods (assessments, diagnostics, implementation guidance, verification procedures) remain blocked pending approved methodology substance.
Disclosure tiers beyond internal, IP referral, and any future runtime application remain unresolved (ADR-0003/ADR-0004 criteria apply if triggered).
Final constitutional allocation of methodological approval authority (interim configurable Founder rule stands).
capabilities.notes: Repository foundation only — no database, application, search service, or user interface exists or is implied.

capabilities.name: Intellectual Property Repository
capabilities.description: Institutional IP Repository. The repository-based governance foundation is complete (the full approved Intellectual Property Foundation v1 source, architecture, schema, registry, six approved governance records, validation); no substantive asset is admitted, and all legally or commercially operative matters remain with Corporate Headquarters / legal authority.
unresolvedDecisions: Substantive asset admission is blocked: each future asset requires an approved source and a separate admission decision (none admitted; the six initial records are governance records).
All legally and commercially operative matters (ownership, protection, registration, licensing, valuation, commercialization) are reserved to Corporate Headquarters / legal authority.
Method Library referrals remain not_referred; future runtime capabilities (search, access control, database) require their own authorization (ADR-0003).
capabilities.notes: Repository foundation only — no runtime application, database, search service, portal, or administrative interface exists or is implied; no legal ownership or rights determinations are made.

capabilities.name: Education Platform
capabilities.description: Institutional Education Platform. Repository-based governance foundation complete (approved Education & Workforce Development Foundation v1, architecture, schema, registry, twelve governance records, validation); no program, learner, assessment, credential, offering, or LMS exists; learner data blocked by privacy/legal governance. Public /education page is positioning only.
unresolvedDecisions: No program, course, pathway, competency library, assessment instrument, credential, or offering exists or is approved: each requires separate Education-authority design, review, and approval (EWDFv1 §20.11, §21, §22.2).
Program approval never implies delivery readiness, enrollment availability, public disclosure, or commercial availability — the ten readiness dimensions remain separate (EWDFv1 §11.4–11.5, §12.2).

Any runtime education system (LMS, learner accounts, portals, dashboards, evidence submission) requires its own authorization under ADR-0003 criteria and ADR-0005 environment isolation; a generic LMS is explicitly not assumed appropriate, and no vendor, AI provider, or hosting model is selected (EWDFv1 §16.9, §19.3).

Production learner, instructor, assessment, organizational, and participation data remains blocked pending privacy and legal governance (EWDFv1 §14.5, §20.10); learner-record retention and disclosure await data-governance policy.

Credentialing, certification, continuing-education, instructor, learner-support, and commercial-model policy remain unresolved (EWDFv1 §20.12–20.14, §21); final constitutional allocation of educational approval authority is pending (interim configurable rule stands).
capabilities.notes: Repository foundation only — no LMS, runtime application, database, authentication, learner data, assessment operation, credential issuance, vendor selection, or public educational offering exists or is implied; repository presence creates no educational approval, and educational approval authorizes no delivery.

capabilities.name: Publishing Platform
capabilities.description: Publishing capability of Huerta Group LLC, implemented and operated by Huerta Group Publishing — the first chartered venture (FD-V1; fd-0007) — in its own repository. Editorial development, deterministic production, and evidence-gated releases operate under chartered delegated authority; commercial activation, distribution, public launch, and legal matters remain reserved.
unresolvedDecisions: Commercial activation, billing, and pricing remain reserved (Corporate Headquarters readiness + Founder Office authorization; Charter §8, §11).

Venture official public launch awaits its own Founder Office determination (parent-platform representation is determined — FD-V4, fd-0009 — with linking gated on launch); general name-use policy awaits FD-V3.
Distribution (ONIX, retail, manufacturing) is out of venture scope; legally operative rights and ISBN matters remain Corporate Headquarters matters.
capabilities.notes: identityRequirement records the parent-architecture reading: no parent identity capability is required or granted. The venture authenticates its own authors and staff on venture-owned infrastructure (Charter §7.3, §13) — venture-internal identity, outside this registry's identity dimension.

capabilities.name: AI Platform
capabilities.description: Future controlled use of institutional knowledge by AI: governed retrieval, permissions, evaluation, traceability. Philosophy exists (Vision Foundation §8); governance and runtime do not.
unresolvedDecisions: AI governance (access policy, decision rights, evaluation standards, data protection) is an owner decision.
Machine-consumption eligibility of every governed document is unresolved (knowledge manifest).

capabilities.name: Operations Systems
capabilities.description: Internal operational capability owned by Corporate Operations & Command Management. Founder Office has determined the trigger FIRED (fd-0011): the recurring internal workflow has outgrown governed documents as the sole operational mechanism. Requirements are authoritative. Architecture and implementation remain PAUSED — a fired trigger establishes need, not authorization.
unresolvedDecisions: Trigger status (fd-0011, Founder Office): FIRED. The recurring internal workflow has outgrown governed documents as the sole operational mechanism. HISTORICAL POSTURE, preserved and not rewritten: this entry previously recorded the trigger as 'the first recurring internal workflow that outgrows governed documents; none identified yet', and the Phase 1 reassessment (fd-0010) found a recurring workflow evidenced but the outgrowing limb not demonstrable on repository evidence alone. The Founder Office determination supplies what repository evidence could not. See institution/governance/operations/operations-systems-capability-trigger-reassessment.md.
A fired trigger is NOT implementation authorization. Technical architecture and implementation remain paused pending methodology readiness and a subsequent Founder Office authorization (fd-0011).

Prospective operational doctrine is required before architecture can resume: the Corporate Operations Semantics Foundation v1 does not yet exist. Its repository location is reserved at institution/foundations/operations/README.md and the unresolved questions it must answer are inventoried in institution/governance/operations/corporate-operations-semantics-definition-package.md. Development is not authorized to draft it.

Operational-instance semantics remain unresolved: active operational record, operational-instance identity, lifecycle and transition semantics, blocker, handoff, deadline, renewal, follow-up, attention, and the materiality rule for change are not established by surviving canonical OSPA (S01-S04, S09, S10), and the sections that would define them are permanently unavailable (S05-S08, S11-S15). No transition model may be inferred from S09 section 9.28 (fd-0011).

The complete Generation One Requirements Report has not been transmitted to the repository; its preservation is incomplete and the semantic-definition package's concept inventory is provisional until it is (fd-0011 Deficiency 1).

capabilities.name: Managed-Service Infrastructure
capabilities.description: Future recurring-delivery systems: service records, schedules, review cycles, evidence, reporting. Public institutional function exists (/managed-services); no delivery systems or service model exist.
unresolvedDecisions: The service model itself (what sustained support concretely includes) is an owner decision.
Blocked until client-delivery foundations mature.

capabilities.name: Client Delivery Systems
capabilities.description: Future engagement records, deliverable standards, secure client access. Early engagements can be delivered with disciplined governed documents; systems come later. Inquiry intake is the only implemented sliver.
unresolvedDecisions: Engagement-record conventions and confidentiality practice precede any system.
Client portals are explicitly deferred until identity, data governance, and demonstrated need exist.

capabilities.name: Research Systems
capabilities.description: Future research records, evidence, provenance, and findings supporting methods, education, IP, and software. Long-term vision only; no requirements exist.
unresolvedDecisions: No near-term requirement; revisit when method or education work generates research records.

capabilities.name: Identity and Access
capabilities.description: Future authentication/authorization shared service for internal and client capabilities. Deliberately absent today (Development Standards: introduced when a capability requires it). Technical user classes only — never institutional offices.
unresolvedDecisions: Provider selection is deliberately open (ADR-0006).
Triggered by the first real internal or client capability that requires authentication; none exists.

capabilities.name: Shared Data Services
capabilities.description: Possible future shared data infrastructure across institutional systems. Exists only as criteria (ADR-0004); the current Supabase project owns inquiry records only and is not the universal Company database.
unresolvedDecisions: Whether future systems share a Supabase project (schema-per-system) or use project-per-system is unresolved until the second data-owning system is authorized (ADR-0004 criteria).

capabilities.name: Platform Operations
capabilities.description: Deployment, environments, secrets, rollback, and (minimal) observability. Operational for the website (Vercel auto-deploy, documented rollback, status-code logging); ecosystem-scale operations are future work.
unresolvedDecisions: Observability and incident response beyond platform logs await the first system whose sensitivity demands them (ADR-0005 triggers).

capabilities.name: Official Launch and Domain Layer
capabilities.description: Owner-gated official-launch execution: domain acquisition/attachment, DNS, canonical cutover, notification activation, launch verification. Fully planned; technically ready; entirely owner-authorized.
unresolvedDecisions: Domain, registrar, apex/www, DNS, notification activation, analytics, and legal review are owner decisions (launch checklist Phase 1).
